name: Judging
overview: Scripture instructs believers to exercise judgment with humility and righteousness, warning against hypocritical and self-condemning attitudes. Jesus teaches not to judge in a way that invites judgment upon ourselves, emphasizing the need to first address our own faults before correcting others. Believers are called to avoid judging by mere appearances and instead pursue righteous judgment that aligns with God's standards. The warnings in Romans highlight the danger of condemning others while engaging in the same sins, underscoring the necessity of self-examination and forgiveness.
